primary_task: Visually inspect a running website with browser automation (navigate, screenshot, multiple viewports), identify design issues and fix them in source code.

requirements.name: browser automation
requirements.evidence: Browser automation must be available - Screenshot capture, Page navigation, DOM information retrieval
requirements.check: command -v playwright; node -e "require('playwright').chromium.launch()...screenshot"; npm view @playwright/mcp version
requirements.observed: playwright 1.56.1 present, chromium in /opt/pw-browsers launched and screenshot taken (4832 bytes); Playwright MCP not connected, @playwright/mcp 0.0.83 resolvable

requirements.name: Read (image analysis)
requirements.evidence: Image Analysis | Visual issue detection | required

requirements.name: Edit/Write/Grep
requirements.evidence: File Read/Write ... Code Search | Required for fixes

notes: Doc recommends Playwright MCP but explicitly accepts other tools (Puppeteer/Selenium/etc.). Target site is a user input; a remote site would also need egress to its host.
